title: sorry i had to return it
text: sorry i had to return it. unfortunately i had to return this  it was a bit too wobbly for my sanity but it was really a nice piece for a monitor stand  i loved the wood and the slot for the phone  in fact there was 2 phone slots  plus one in the back to lay one down  but it was held together by only 6 screws and i just wasnt happy with that  if they'd improve on it being sturdier  that would be better i was uneasy putting an expensive computer to sit on top of it  so it was returned for a refund

product_metadata.title: SONGMICS Bamboo Monitor Stand Riser, Ergonomic, Desktop Organizer, with Phone, Cup, Keyboard Storage, for Computer, 23.6", Black
features: NO MORE ERGONOMIC NIGHTMARE: Why strain your neck and back when typing? Raise your computer to eye level with this monitor stand and work comfortably with a healthy sitting posture
TIDY UP YOUR WORKSTATION: No matter pens, clips, stickers or your phone, all of them can find their places on this desk organizer. Want a cup of joe during break time? It also has the space for that!

KEYBOARD HAS ITS PLACE, TOO: Need a large monitor stand that can also be used for tucking away your keyboard when not in use? Check out this stand! With the size of 23.6”L x 11.9”W x 3.3”H, it fits the bill perfectly

SAY HELLO TO BAMBOO: Renewable? Durable? They are only parts of the benefits this bamboo monitor riser offers. Its fine grain and inherently sleek beauty also bring a refreshing feeling to your office
WHAT YOU GET: A bamboo monitor stand that raises your computer to a comfortable height and organizes your cup, cellphone, sticky notes and pens for a neat desktop while working

details.Included Components: 1 x Instruction, 1 x Tool, 1 x Bamboo Monitor Stand ONLY
